# tbx

> A toolbox of small command line tools with shared runtime helpers.

## Docs

- [Tool catalog](catalog.md): every tool with its alias, language and summary
- [Shared modules](shared/index.md): helpers every tool reuses

## Tools

- [transcribe](../tools/transcribe/README.md): Turn a video URL into a clean markdown transcript

## Shared modules

- [py/cli](shared/py/cli.md): ToolContext, build_command, define_tool, load_manifest, run_tool, usage_of
- [ts/cli](shared/ts/cli.md): OptionValue, ToolContext, ToolRun, ToolUsage, UsageOption, defineTool, reportError, runTool, usageOf
- [py/errors](shared/py/errors.md): ExitCode, ToolError
- [ts/errors](shared/ts/errors.md): ExitCode, ToolError, errorLines, isErrnoException, messageOf
- [ts/gen-parser](shared/ts/gen-parser.md): generateShellParser
- [ts/gen/completions](shared/ts/gen/completions.md): CompletionShell, renderCompletions
- [ts/gen/contract](shared/ts/gen/contract.md): CONTRACT_PLACEHOLDER, ContractCase, INTEGER_ACCEPTED, INTEGER_REJECTED, generateContractTests
- [ts/gen/files](shared/ts/gen/files.md): GENERATED_MARKER, GeneratedFile, compareText
- [ts/gen/index](shared/ts/gen/index.md): checkDrift, generateAll, loadToolManifests, syncGenerated, undocumentedSymbols, writeGenerated
- [ts/gen/readme](shared/ts/gen/readme.md): ReadmeOptions, renderCatalog, renderToolReadme
- [ts/gen/shared-docs](shared/ts/gen/shared-docs.md): DOC_EXTRACT_TIMEOUT_MS, SharedModuleDoc, SharedSymbol, extractSharedDocs, missingSharedDocs, renderSharedDocs
- [ts/gen/unit](shared/ts/gen/unit.md): UnitContext, UnitKind, UnitValidation, VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT_MS, renderSystemdTimer, renderUnit, unitLabel, validateUnit
- [sh/lib](shared/sh/lib.md): tbx_die, tbx_error, tbx_info, tbx_result, tbx_result_json
- [ts/manifest](shared/ts/manifest.md): ArgSpec, BUILTIN_OPTIONS, INTEGER_PATTERN, INTEGER_RULE, ManifestError, NAME_PATTERN, OptSpec, PathCollision, RESERVED_COMMANDS, ToolManifest, UnitSpec, assertNoCollisions, describePathCollision, findPathCollisions, loadManifest, parseIntegerText, parseManifest
- [py/output](shared/py/output.md): Output
- [ts/output](shared/ts/output.md): Output, OutputStreams, PROCESS_STREAMS, createOutput
- [ts/paths](shared/ts/paths.md): EXECUTABLE_MODE, PRIVATE_DIR_MODE, PathBinary, PathEnv, READABLE_MODE, binariesOnPath, findOnPath, isWithin, tbxBinDir, xdgBaseDir
- [ts/pty](shared/ts/pty.md): PtyOptions, PtyResult, runInPty
- [py/retry](shared/py/retry.md): retry_policy, with_retry
- [ts/run](shared/ts/run.md): CapturedOutput, CommandError, MAX_CAPTURE_BYTES, RunOptions, RunResult, captureOutput, runBounded, runOpen, signalGroup
